MLX-5000 Series Universal Gauge


From Dakota Digital

The new Dakota Digital MLX-5000 Series provides a small form factor handlebar mount instrument system, including all of the bare necessities, along with customization options to suit your bike’s styling. 

The integrated electronic speedometer can read to 255 MPH or KM/H, selectable by the user.  Million-Mile odometer and a pair of resettable Trip Odometers are standard, along with hidden indicator lamps:  Left and Right Turn Signal, High Beam, Neutral, Low Oil Pressure and Check Engine.

Center TFT display auto-dims to allow ideal day and night visibility, while giving the user the ability to choose from 30 lighting colors and styles. This programmable readout also has the capability of displaying a variety of performance calculations, such as 0-60 Timer, ¼ mile time and speed, service mileage and more!  All features are accessed through a front-mounted tactile pushbutton switch.

This new series provides universal wiring inputs, allowing for compatibility with a range of bikes providing discrete signal inputs, but is not suggested for use on DATA/CAN bus models.

The MLX-5000 Series can be use with all Dakota Digital handlebar or riser mount brackets. Choose from your choice of a Chrome or Black finish, along with a Classic Oval (MLX-5400) or Spiked (MLX-5200) housing style.

Dimensions:

MLX-5200:   4-1/2" x 2"
MLX-5400:   3-1/2" x 2"
